dominant_stage: Gymnasium environment wrapper & Python observation dictionary construction
finding: Of the 1.60 ms total closed-loop step time, raw MuJoCo physics (20 substeps) accounts for 0.83 ms (51.8%), ONNX quantized inference takes 0.14 ms (8.4%), observation formatting takes 0.009 ms, and Gymnasium wrapper overhead (Python observation dictionary construction and bounds checking) accounts for 0.63 ms (39.2%). Gymnasium wrapper/Python glue dominates.
